source.stem:
The table describes four different resistance wires. They are all made from the same metal.
Which wire has the smallest resistance?

length of diameter of wire / m 3.0; wire / mm 1.0
length of diameter of wire / m 3.0; wire / mm 1.5

intelligence.enrichment: Conduction transfers heat by contact from particle to particle, convection transfers heat by the actual movement of liquid or gas particles, and radiation transfers heat directly from a hot object to its surroundings. The pathway of heat transfer determines the name of the process: contact through a solid indicates conduction, moving fluid indicates convection, and direct transfer from a hot object indicates radiation. The learner correctly applies this rule: Conduction transfers heat by contact from particle to particle, convection transfers heat by the actual movement of liquid or gas particles, and radiation transfers heat directly from a hot object to its surroundings. Any heat coming from a flame is called radiation, no matter whether it warms a pan, water, or a person.
